dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I need to clear out some... mental detritus before I head down to the clinic.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: Hmm, too direct? How about "mental load"? Would that be easier to understand?

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: Many people gain greater self-awareness or deeper knowledge through meditation.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: But I'm not looking for anything quite so profound. All I require is inner peace.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: Know that sometimes, helping others with their treatment is no different from becoming an active part of their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: This is especially true for those who have chronic illnesses, such as those afflicted with Abyssal corrosion.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: In such cases, I regularly compile medical reports and keep a running record of their condition. As such, it is inevitable that I occasionally find myself dwelling upon such thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: Yet this can have negative effects on my own health.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: It is hard for doctors to cure themselves, though, so all I can hope for is to temporarily free my mind of these troubles through meditation.

dialogues.speaker: Matla
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Why'd I make that play? Strange...
